summary: Fixed RingBuffer.append in Sources/RingBuffer/RingBuffer.swift:18-27. The old code always wrote at (head + stored) % capacity and only incremented `stored` when not full, so when the buffer was full it overwrote the newest slot (tail) instead of the oldest, and never advanced `head` — breaking FIFO order after wraparound. Now, when full, append overwrites storage[head] and advances head; otherwise it appends at the tail as before. Verified: `swift test --build-system native --disable-sandbox` exits 0, all 4 tests pass. No test files were modified.
